name: Marcy Chaplains
description: The Marcy Chaplains, also known as the Marcy Ave Chaplains, were a youth street gang active in Brooklyn, New York during the 1950s and into the early 1960s. Based around Marcy Avenue in the Bedford-Stuyvesant neighborhood, they were part of the so-called 'jitterbugging' gang era that defined New York City street gang culture of the period. They had documented interactions with other Brooklyn gangs including the Buccaneers and the Immortal Sinners.
